notes.title: Development Update: A Before-and-After Progress Report
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings, Intergalactic Diner Managers!
[/h3]
A belated happy new year to everyone. What better time than now to take a moment to reflect and look back on all the progress we've made in the last 12 months - and we've made plenty!

From a complete UI overhaul to tons of QoL improvements, new objects and animations to bug fixes, we're getting closer and closer to a release-ready build.

But why read all this when you can see it for yourself -- watch the video below and see us put a build from exactly one year ago side-by-side with our latest build for comparison.

[previewyoutube=tyg2xup20t4;full][/previewyoutube]
On top of that, we're also hoping to get a demo ready in the next month - and once we do, we'll make sure to release an update.

So do stay tuned, and if you haven't already, add us to your wishlist and give us a follow on Steam.

Speak to you all again very soon!

[b]The General Interactive Team[/b]
